name: University of Rajshahi
about: The University of Rajshahi is a public research university founded on 6 July 1953, the second university in what was then East Bengal. It began with 161 students and six departments in temporary premises before moving to its 753-acre campus at Motihar on the bank of the Padma. It has 12 faculties, 59 departments and 6 institutes, with over 25,000 students and 1,200 teachers.
